*   **Time Complexity**: The LRU update requires processing the usage buffer and computing an exclusive scan, which is $O(Csize)$ per frame [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly states that the LRU buffer is updated each frame. It details that this process involves processing the usage buffer to produce a mask and then computing an exclusive scan of that mask. The evidence defines Csize as the cache size and Usize (the size of the usage buffer) as being directly derived from Csize (Usize = Csize / Bsize). Since the operations (processing the usage buffer and computing the exclusive scan) are performed on data structures whose size is linearly proportional to Csize, the claim that the complexity is O(Csize) is supported by the described implementation details.
